title: Harbour Now
description: Identify observed ships around Halifax and Vancouver, explore recorded harbour movements, and compare time observed at anchor.

data_info.detail: A separately installed VPS collector records AISStream observations continuously. Position dates, observation gaps and approximate boundaries are explicit. Requires a connected collector.

title: Screen Places
description: Explore documented film and television locations across Canadian regions, compare location precision and save an outing.

data_info.detail: Weekly regional Wikidata filming-location captures across Canada, with optional live TMDb details.

title: Wiki Trails
description: Discover nearby history, buildings and landmarks from Wikipedia, then save a personal walking list.

data_info.detail: Wikipedia geotagged articles and excerpts near a chosen place, with OpenStreetMap tiles.

title: Address Chronicle
description: Search historical Vancouver and Halifax directories by address, street, person or business, with original scanned-page citations.

data_info.detail: Page-indexed Internet Archive OCR from selected historical Vancouver and Halifax directories;monthly source checks.

title: Torrent Lens
description: Inspect torrent files and magnet links locally: see files, sizes, hashes, trackers and filename warnings without downloading the content.

data_info.detail: Reads torrent metadata or magnet links locally. Does not contact trackers, join peers or download the described files.

title: Sky Geometry
description: Convert RA and declination to altitude and azimuth, plan target visibility and compare sky coordinates in your browser.

data_info.detail: Astronomy Engine calculates fixed sky-coordinate transformations locally from your location, date and selected coordinate system.

title: Budget Mirror
description: Compare your household spending with published Canadian averages, privately in your browser.

data_info.detail: Statistics Canada household spending averages, with private comparisons calculated in your browser.

title: Move Bench
description: Compare two places using your rent, job offers and moving costs to see the monthly difference.

data_info.detail: Your private pay and cost scenarios, with separately labelled Statistics Canada provincial household-spending context.

title: Canada Pulse
description: Explore Wikipedia reading trends in Canada and worldwide interest in Canadian topics.

data_info.detail: Wikimedia daily Canadian readership rankings and worldwide user pageviews for configurable Canadian topics, with a growing dated archive and daily scheduled checks.

title: Plane Here
description: Identify aircraft near you by callsign, direction, distance and altitude, with dated ADS-B observations.

data_info.detail: Community ADS-B observations from adsb.lol, shared in five-minute area snapshots with individual position times.
